summary: App to periodically generate mouse movement to prevent the PC from sleeping/hibernating.
architectural_notes: Production deployment domain names must be 5–50 characters and contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens (no parentheses or other symbols).
Use production domain name "awake01" for deployment.
known_issues: Production deployment failed due to invalid domain name not meeting allowed format/length constraints.

existing_features.title: Create a single-page app UI that lets the user prevent the computer display from sleeping while the page is open, with controls for Start/Stop, an optional duration (e.g., 15/30/60 minutes or unlimited), and a visible status indicator (Running/Stopped/Expired/Unsupported).

Implement keep-awake behavior using the Screen Wake Lock API (navigator.wakeLock) when available, including proper release on Stop, page visibility changes, and tab/window close; when Wake Lock is not supported or fails, show a clear fallback message explaining that browsers cannot move the OS mouse cursor and that the app cannot guarantee preventing sleep on all systems.

Add a small Settings section to configure: (1) auto-start on page load (toggle), (2) default duration, and (3) whether to keep the screen awake only while the tab is visible (toggle). Persist these settings in localStorage.

Apply a coherent, creative visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) suitable for a simple utility app, and enforce it consistently across the page (avoid a blue/purple-dominant palette).
Add a small static illustration/logo asset and display it in the app header.

Add a user-facing toggle to enable or disable the periodic mouse-movement (“mouse jiggle”) behavior, and persist the toggle value in the same localStorage-backed settings model used by the existing keep-awake settings.

Implement periodic mouse-movement behavior on the frontend that runs only while the app is in the Running state AND the new setting is enabled; ensure it starts on Start, stops on Stop/Expire, and is cleaned up on page hide/unload to avoid orphaned intervals.

Add clear user-facing explanatory text near the mouse-movement toggle describing the limitation that browsers may not be able to move the OS cursor and that the feature may not prevent sleep/hibernate on all systems, consistent with the app’s existing guidance about browser limitations.

Retry production deployment using the domain name "awake01" (and only that domain change) so the deployment meets the platform domain naming rules (5–50 characters; letters, numbers, and hyphens only) and completes successfully.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create an app that generates periodic mouse movement so the PC does not sleep/hibernate.
Add a user-facing toggle to enable/disable the periodic mouse-movement behavior.
Add a small UI indicator showing when mouse-movement (“jiggle”) mode is active.

projectName: Keep-awake web app (prevent sleep) with Wake Lock and timer controls
